content.text: {"off_topic":false,"weekend_overview":{"glance":"The Watchtower Study looks at how patience with one another reflects Jehovah’s own patience with us.","jehovah":[{"quality":"Patient","text":"He gives people time to change instead of giving up on them.","ref":"2 Peter 3:9"}]},"watchtower_study":{"title":"Be Patient With One Another","summary":"The article shows why patience matters at home and in the congregation, and how Jehovah’s example helps us stay calm.","notes":[{"paragraphs":"1–4","text":"Patience is more than waiting; it is staying kind while we wait.","ref":"Galatians 5:22"},{"paragraphs":"5–9","text":"Jehovah’s patience with Israel shows how far his patience reaches.","ref":"Nehemiah 9:30"}],"jehovah":[{"text":"He is slow to anger and quick to forgive.","ref":"Exodus 34:6"}],"comments":[{"paragraph":"7","text":"I try to give my family the same patience Jehovah gives me.","ref":""}]}}
